request.initial_prompt: "Offer a prayer, sir," said he, "to King Neptune, for it is his feast that you are joining; when you have duly prayed and made your drink offering, pass the cup to your friend that he may do so also. I doubt not that he too lifts his hands in prayer, for man cannot live without God in the world. Still he is younger than you are, and is much of an age with myself, so I will give you the precedence."
request.hotwords: Offer, King, Neptune, I, God, Still

raw_segments.text: Offer a prayer, sir," said he, to King Neptune, for it is his feast that you are joining, when you have duly prayed and made your drink offering, pass the cup to your friend that he may do so also.

I doubt not that he too lifts his hands in prayer, for man cannot live without God in the world. Still he is younger than you are, and is much of an age with myself, so I will give you the precedence.
